title: Restricted Mean Survival from Combined Incident and Prevalent Cohorts with Entry Calibration
banked_reason: D0.5 below-floor verdict: incremental < field; exact minimax converse remains open, while the feasible estimator and calibrated inference results form the sound residual package.
gap_reasons: The sharp matched-minimax headline is not established because the van Trees proof requires uniform Fisher-information control under P_{n,t}, whereas the LAN lemma only proves a likelihood-ratio expansion under P_{n,0}.

Panel findings left unrepaired (the tier, not these, is the reason for the halt): lower-bound-derivative-gap@thm:frontier-minimax-law, dropped-evaluation-allocation-factors@lem:fixed-log-feasible-linearization.
D0.5.G tier=incremental < floor=field (target=field) and NOT salvageable in scope
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery constructed a normalized recruitment-preserving observed-law path, a feasible calibrated pooled estimator, and Gaussian/studentized inference for m=floor(n/log n). The sharp minimax converse failed because the pointwise LAN calculation did not establish uniform path-score Fisher information required by van Trees; the initial feasible variance calculation also omitted post-split allocation factors, which were corrected before banking. The converse is now an explicit open question, while the residual fixed-log estimator and calibration calculations remain as run-specific results below the field novelty floor.
tldr: With \(m_n=\lfloor n/\log n\rfloor\) incident cases and \(n\) stationary prevalent survivors, one observable entry-calibrated pooled delayed-entry product-limit estimator has uniform leading mean-squared error \(C_N\log\log n/n\), a uniform Gaussian approximation, a consistent finite-dimensional variance plug-in, and uniformly valid Wald coverage.  In the four-cell law, calibration reduces the leading estimator MSE coefficient by exactly \(25/6048\).  A matching local minimax converse is unproved and remains open.
gap: Fixed-fraction biased-sampling theory, regular combined-cohort survival estimators, and fixed-mix recruitment design do not determine what happens when the incident fraction vanishes polynomially and lifetime smoothness itself regularizes the unobserved early-time region.
fill: The project derives the \(5/6\) transition from two exact recruitment-preserving observed-law LAN paths and a matching \(C^2\) modulus, matches the lower bound with the determinate pooled/profile hybrid and exact entry-frequency projection, proves uniform score-sandwich studentization, and identifies the strict inefficiency region of the ordinary pooled product limit.
